text: 68-year-old male. The patient reports having a fever, cough, weakness, night sweats, and poor appetite persisting for 6 months. He has lost 7.5 kg (16.5 lb) over this period. No history of breathlessness, nasal discharge, nasal obstruction, palpitations, chest pain, or digestive symptoms. Released from prison 9 months ago after a 2-year sentence.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Tuberculosis (Reactivation).

Based on your 6-month history of fever, night sweats, significant weight loss, and recent incarceration, despite the initial negative skin test, the clinical picture strongly suggests active pulmonary tuberculosis, possibly with false-negative results due to prior BCG vaccination or anergy. I will proceed with a Sputum Acid-Fast Bacilli (AFB) smear and culture for confirmation.
